verses.text: Ix yalan winhaj Saúl t'a winhaj Jonatán yet' t'a heb' ay yopisio to smilcham winhaj David heb'. Palta te xajan winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi',
yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Wan snaan winh in mam ach smilchamok. Yuj chi' te lista tzutej a b'a k'ik'an, tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'a junok b'aj te k'ub'eltak.
Yujto a k'ik'an chi', tzin b'at yet' winh in mam chi' t'a slak'anil b'aj ayach ek' chi', swalan t'a winh uuj, tzaxo wal t'ayach tas tz'aj yalan winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Jonatán t'a winh smam chi' yuj tastak wach' sk'ulej winhaj David chi' icha tik: --Mamin, manh wach'ok tato tzach och ajk'olal t'a winhaj David a chekab', yujto malaj b'aj tz'och smul winh t'ayach, yujto niwan tas wach' ix ik' t'a spatik winh.

Ix ila' to ix sb'ek sb'a winh schami ayik ix smilancham winh filisteo winh, icha chi' ix aj skolchaj ko chonhab' tik yuj Jehová. Ha jun chi' ix il wal. Ix ach te tzalaji. ¿Tas yuj tza na' a milcham winh, ina to malaj jab'ok smul winh t'ayach? xchi winh.
Ix scha yab' winhaj Saúl chi' tas ix yal winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh: --Tik swak' kan in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol in milcham winh, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix awtaj winhaj David chi' yuj winhaj Jonatán chi', ix yalan winh tas ix aj yalan winh smam chi' t'ay. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj David chi' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', ix ochxi winh t'a yopisio t'a stz'ey winhaj Saúl chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ochxi owal junelxo yet' heb' filisteo, ix elixta winhaj David chi' yak' owal yet' heb', te niwan heb' ix smilcham winh, yuj chi' ix el lemnaj heb' t'a winh.

Haxo pax winhaj Saúl chi', ix ochxi jun espíritu chuk t'a winh yuj Jehová. k'ojanem winh t'a yol spat, yet'nakk'e k'een slanza winh, haxo winhaj David chi' wan schalan te' arpa winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Ix yik'anchaanh k'een slanza winh rey chi', ix sjulanoch k'een winh t'a winhaj David yik tz'ochkan ch'apan winh t'a sat pat chi' yuj k'een yalani, palta ix skol sb'a winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix b'atkan ch'apan k'een lanza chi' t'a sat pat chi'. Ix el lemnaj winhaj David t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix b'at winh t'a spat.

Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yal winhaj Saúl chi' to sb'at och stanhwumal winhaj David chi' t'a spat, yik wach' haxo t'a junxo q'uinhib'alil, b'at miljokcham winh. Haxo ix Mical yetb'eyum winh ix halan t'ay: --Tato manh ol a kol a b'a t'a jun ak'wal tik, k'ik'an chamnak hachxo, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anelta jun ch'anh lasu ix t'a jun wentena, hata' ix emta winhaj David chi' yik skolan sb'a.

Ix yik'ankot jun sdiosal ix, ix yak'anek' jichan ix t'a sat sch'at winhaj David chi'. Ix yak'anoch juntzanh xil nok' chiwa ix jalb'il t'a sjolom jun sdiosal chi', ix yak'anb'at jun sábana ix t'a yib'anh.
Ayik ix yak'anb'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl b'at syam winhaj David chi', ix yalan ix Mical to penaay winh.
Ix schekanxib'at heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekkot winh t'a sat sch'at chi' t'a tik, a in ol in milcham winh, xchi winh.
Ix och heb' t'a yol spat winhaj David chi' yik syilan heb', tikni anhej jun yechel jichanek' t'a sat ch'at chi', ayoch jun xil chiwa sk'anh jolomok. Ix b'at yalan heb' t'a winhaj Saúl chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Saúl chi' t'a ix Mical chi': --¿Tas yuj tzin ixtej, tza kolanel jun winh wajk'ol chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Yujto ix yal winh t'ayin: Ol ach in milchamok tato max in a chaeli, xchi winh, xchi ix.

Icha chi' ix aj skolchaj winhaj David chi'. Ix b'at skolan sb'a winh b'aj ay winhaj Samuel t'a Ramá. Ix yalan winh t'a winh tas ix utaj yuj winhaj Saúl chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Samuel chi' yet' winh t'a Naiot yik b'at kajnaj heb' winh ta'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' to ha t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá ayek' winhaj David chi',

ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh yik b'at ik'jokkot winh. Ayik ix k'och heb' chekab' chi', ix yilan juntzanh heb' schekab' Jehová heb', wan sb'itan heb' yuj Yespíritu Dios, haxo winhaj Samuel chi' skuchb'an heb'. Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Saúl chi', ix och heb' t'a skal heb', ix b'itan heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Saúl chi', ix yak'anb'at junxo makan heb' schekab' winh. Hanheja' ix ochpax heb' t'a skal heb' wan sb'itan chi'.

Yuj chi', a wal winhaj Saúl chi' ix b'at ilanok, haxo yik ix k'och winh t'a jun niwan uk'b'ila' ay t'a Sekú, ix sk'anb'an winh b'ajtil ayek' winhaj Samuel yet' winhaj David. Ay mach ix halan t'a winh to hato t'a Naiot t'a yol yik Ramá ayek' heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh ta'. Elanhchamel ix ochpax Yespíritu Dios t'a winh, yakb'an wan sb'ey winh, ix och ijan winh sb'itani masanto ix k'och winh t'a Naiot chi'.

Ix yik'anel spichul winh yik sreyal, komon animaxonhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh winhaj Samuel chi' ayik ix b'itan winh chi'. Ichaxonhej chi' ix yutej sb'a winh ix ek' k'u yet' ix ek' ak'wal. Ha yuj jun chi' ix elta jun lolonel tz'alji: Ipan pax winhaj Saúl ayoch t'a skal heb' schekab' Dios, xchi.
